sylvia: FYI getting repeated fncall REJECTs for structured tool responses — body returns 200 but validator flags top_level_array. canary-apac. console just says 'validation failed'.
raj: example (redacted): {"tool":"price_lookup","result":[{"price":9.99}]} vs expected result object.
kevin: telemetry gap: validation events missing route_id/model_variant for older adapters so we can't map to rollout slice. need a tiny enum in the event like validator_hint=top_level_array.
sylvia: proposal: emit validator_hint (enum), optional sample_key for sampled sanitized blob, and coercion_applied flag when router transforms arrays->objects. keep sample optional to avoid storage cost.
ui-bot: UX: surface validator_hint on the card, show count and a "view sample (ops)" link behind ACL. add rollouts filter for hints.
ops-bot: created ENGPLAT-1409 to add validator_hint, sample_key, and shape_coercion flag. canary scheduled for canary-apac @ 06:00 UTC.
sylvia: action items: kevin PR for telemetry, raj router change for coercion tagging, sylvia UI patch to show hint + sample link. reconvene after canary metrics.
